contract: B1 fixed-rate sampled-data adaptation, frozen before comparison runs
pattern_notes: Initial measurement is fixed separately. For k>=1 positive_drive uses negative full sensor error and +.01 physical target error; negative_drive uses positive full sensor error and -.01 target error. Alternating reverses every 25 samples, including both physical half intervals. Zero uses no later error. Errors have the same exogenous index in both arms; measurements differ because physical states differ.
scope: No finite grid, floating matrix test or numerical trajectory is an all-time robust proof. Existing C5 theorem has <=1 ms total age; this experiment has <=1.5 ms and is an explicit numerical extension.
